name: the marriageable-men drive SATURATES in relative male income (Hill, not linear)
evidence: marriageability q responds to income via q_max·I/(I50+I) (n=1 Langmuir; near-origin slope 0.03 ΔTFR/boom from Kearney-Wilson, I50=14 booms); the drive-alone ceiling on Korea is +0.374 ΔTFR (reachable TFR 0.54) - the E22 '+0.48 drive alone' is the ASYMPTOTE, not a way-point; the positional market stops paying once rank is restored

name: an unevenly-landing (concentrated) boom partly self-cancels via the Doepke inequality channel
evidence: a fully-concentrated lift (κ=1) bites -0.066 ΔTFR on Korea vs the broad-based drive (Doepke-Zilibotti: inequality raises intensive-parenting stakes → quantum P̄ falls); net-positive only when broad-based

name: lifting men without matching female footing worsens the hypergamy squeeze and cuts coupling
evidence: a men-only lift (gap=1) bites -0.112 ΔTFR on Korea through the coupling channel (Esteve 2016 end-of-hypergamy; Autor asymmetry: female-intensive shocks move marriage the opposite way); the squeeze is convex in the gap, so 'just lift men' backfires past a point

name: the degrees route is worse contemporaneously (arms-race) but writes a delayed path-integral dividend
evidence: the education route bites -0.129 now (arms-race + postponement, E22-H175 ~0.18) yet the childhood-env term feeds the 27-45yr cohort-memory path integral: degrees gen-1 +0.015 → gen-4 +0.138 vs income gen-1 +0.132 → gen-4 +0.278; income still dominates on both horizons

name: the female arm is sign-conditional: female income is fertility-positive only under home equity
evidence: female-income ΔTFR on Korea runs -0.019 at γ=0.1 (specialisation, double-burden postponement) to +0.135 at γ=0.9 (equity), crossing zero near γ≈0.50 (Doepke-Kindermann; Goldscheider gender revolution)

name: broad-based / redistributive delivery counters the inequality backlash and restores net-positive
evidence: switching fiscal redistribution on over a concentrated lift recovers +0.066 ΔTFR on Korea (κ_eff = κ(1-r)); the lever's sign is a property of the DELIVERY, not just the size

name: the full fanout (broad + equity + female arm + fiscal) beats the drive ceiling by stacking channels
evidence: the contrarian bundle bends Korea +0.908 vs the drive-alone ceiling +0.374, because it recruits security + coupling + the female arm - separate saturating channels - rather than over-driving the one marriageability channel (consistent with the E18 'one lever per channel' law)

name: the honest saturating dose overturns the linear '12 to hold, 48 to recover'
evidence: on the saturating curve, HOLD 0.72 needs ∞ (above the drive ceiling), BEND 1.0 ∞, RECOVER 1.5 ∞ (above the ceiling +0.374); the E22 linear line said 18/44 booms - saturation makes recover-by-income-alone unreachable at any finite dose

name: the 'strongest single lever / only one that bends Korea' claim is QUALIFIED, not overturned
evidence: broad-based male income still bends all three (Korea +0.274, Germany +0.433, France +0.293) and remains the strongest single positive channel - BUT it is not monotone or unbounded: a concentrated men-only delivery collapses to +0.124 on Korea, and it cannot recover any region alone. It bends, it does not recover; and only its BROAD-BASED, gender-balanced form is the strong lever
